caption: Making these weekly in my house!  Recipe:  2 cups of flour  1/2 teaspoon baking powder  1 1/4 cup of sweet potato puree  4 tablespoons of melted butter  1/3-1/2 cup grated cheese  Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.  You can add any spices you might want!  I toss mine in melted butter + garlic + parsley flakes for added flavor but not necessary! You can also just toss in melted butter + salt for kids who might not want the green bits 🌿#fallbaking #momof3 #toddlersnacks ##homemade
